final_report: The patient exhibits significant cumulative hematologic toxicity (early severe granulocytopenia, thrombocytopenia, recurrent anemia) and late-onset metabolic derangements (diabetes, dyslipidemia), indicating substantial bone marrow suppression and steroid-related effects. However, preserved functional status (ECOG 1) and absence of acute organ failure mitigate immediate life-threatening risk, resulting in a moderate mortality risk.
